name: Single-phase two-winding transformer
summary: A single-phase two-winding transformer transfers energy between separate primary and secondary windings.
description: A single-phase two-winding transformer transfers energy between separate primary and secondary windings. Voltage ratio, power rating, earthing and terminal polarity require annotations beyond a generic drawing outline.
